cases: null device or error regulator returns -ENODEV
already-enabled regulator returns success without a second enable
disabled valid regulator calls regulator_enable and returns success
regulator_enable failure propagates the observed error and logs it
limitations: The host harness validates the helper with regulator stubs; it does not drive a real regulator on NX809J.
Electrical ramp timing, power-rail dependencies and concurrent power transitions remain separate runtime gates.
